description: A React functional component representing a booking page for a bike taxi platform. It contains form fields for pickup location, dropoff location, payment method, and optional notes, along with logic for submitting a ride booking via an API call.

methods.name: BookingPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders the booking form and handles user interactions and form submission.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Event handler for form submission that sends booking data to the API and navigates to the tracking page upon success.
